ironfarm.name: Iron Farm Design Wheelchair
ironfarm.author: Author: Heishan Dashu
ironfarm.cond.adult.desc: Baby villagers do not sleep and never take part in summoning.
ironfarm.cond.slept.desc: Must have been in a bed within the last 24000 ticks. This is the condition most farms trip over, which is why most only run at night.
ironfarm.cond.no_golem: No iron golem detected in 30 seconds
ironfarm.cond.no_golem.desc: Each villager scans a 33x33x33 box around itself every 10 seconds. If a golem was seen, it must wait another 30 seconds.
ironfarm.cond.no_summon.desc: No villager within 10 blocks in every direction summoned a golem during the last 30 seconds.
ironfarm.cond.panicking.desc: A villager-hostile mob (zombie, pillager, ...) is close enough and has a clear line of sight.
ironfarm.cond.gossiping.desc: Villagers are gossiping. Trading, curing, attacking or killing villagers all generate gossip.
ironfarm.cond.panic_group.desc: At least 3 qualified villagers within 10 blocks are panicking together.
ironfarm.cond.gossip_group.desc: At least 5 qualified villagers within 10 blocks, with at least one of them gossiping.
ironfarm.cond.spawn_point.desc: Inside the 17x13x17 box around the villager, at least one position passes every spawn requirement.
ironfarm.reason.sleep_expired: Last sleep was over 20 minutes ago
ironfarm.reason.golem_detected: An iron golem was detected in the last 30 seconds
ironfarm.reason.near_summon: A nearby villager summoned a golem in the last 30 seconds
ironfarm.reason.no_spawn_point: No valid spawn point in the 17x13x17 box
ironfarm.reason.spawn_area_unloaded: The spawn area chunk is not loaded
ironfarm.reason.chunk_unloaded: The villager's chunk is not loaded
ironfarm.spawn.reject.no_surface: Nothing to stand on in this column
ironfarm.spawn.reject.no_full_top: The block below has no full top surface
ironfarm.spawn.reject.full_block_above: A full block occupies one of the 3 spawn blocks
ironfarm.spawn.reject.powered: The spawn position is redstone powered
ironfarm.spawn.reject.water_above: Water is directly above the spawn position
ironfarm.spawn.reject.entity_collision: An entity already occupies the spawn position
ironfarm.gui.villager_status.title: Villager status (#%s)
ironfarm.gui.settings.master.desc: Stops the mod completely: no scanning, no statistics, no item voiding, no right-click. Same as uninstalling it.
ironfarm.gui.settings.overlay.desc: Shows three icons above each villager: conditions met, panicking, gossip baseline.
ironfarm.gui.settings.bed_lines.desc: Draws coloured lines from each villager to the bed it is bound to.
ironfarm.gui.settings.spawn_box.desc: Draws the 17x13x17 spawn box as a wireframe.
ironfarm.gui.settings.panic_lines.desc: Draws coloured lines from scaring mobs to the villagers they scare. Links that are too far away are dashed.
ironfarm.gui.settings.golem_box.desc: Draws the 33x33x33 detection box each villager scans every 10 seconds.
ironfarm.mob.zombie.advice: Radius 8. The most common scaring mob. Burns in daylight, so shade it or trap it in water with a boat.
ironfarm.mob.husk.advice: Radius 8. Does not burn in daylight, so it suits open-air farms better, but is rarer than zombies.
ironfarm.mob.drowned.advice: Radius 8. Does not burn underwater, commonly used in underwater machine rooms.
ironfarm.mob.zombie_villager.advice: Radius 8. Note: curing it creates positive gossip in nearby villagers.
ironfarm.mob.vex.advice: Radius 8. Flies through walls and cannot be caged, so it is a poor long-term scaring mob.
ironfarm.mob.vindicator.advice: Radius 10. High melee damage and it will kill villagers, so keep it separated.
ironfarm.mob.evoker.advice: Radius 12. Summons vexes and fangs, extremely dangerous, not recommended.
ironfarm.mob.illusioner.advice: Radius 12. Unobtainable in vanilla survival, command spawn only.
ironfarm.mob.ravager.advice: Radius 12. Tramples crops, deals heavy damage and cannot be contained in a boat.
ironfarm.mob.pillager.advice: Radius 15, the largest coverage. You must break its crossbow first or it will shoot villagers and golems. Does not burn in daylight.
ironfarm.mob.zoglin.advice: Radius 10. Spawns only in the Nether; needs a portal or spawn egg in the overworld.
ironfarm.mob.wither.advice: Verified from the game code: a wither does NOT scare villagers. It cannot be used for iron farming.
ironfarm.mob.frostbite.advice: Frostbite is not in the 1.21.1 panic radius table, so it does not scare villagers. It only infects them.
ironfarm.mob.custom.advice: This mob is not in the built-in table; the radius comes from the pack registration.
ironfarm.msg.chunk_unloaded: The villager's chunk is not loaded, cannot evaluate
ironfarm.about.line1: Brings iron farm logic into the game.
ironfarm.about.line2: Overhead icons show at a glance whether a villager can spawn; the statistics tab shows what blocks it.
ironfarm.gui.stats.multiplayer_warning: Multiplayer: the client receives no server events, so spawn counts are incomplete
ironfarm.gui.stats.avg_leave.tip: How long a golem takes to leave every villager's detection range after spawning. Smaller means the collection system reacts faster; if it approaches the lifetime, the golem is probably stuck at the spawn point.
ironfarm.gui.stats.avg_alive.tip: Average time from a golem appearing to disappearing. Compare with the row above: leaving detection much sooner than dying is normal (it falls, gets collected, then dies at the kill point). If the two are close, golems are not being collected.
ironfarm.gui.stats.discarded.tip: Golems that disappeared before leaving detection range (usually a chunk unload). Their real duration is unknown, so they are excluded from the averages. A large number means you are too far from the farm or the simulation distance is small.
ironfarm.gui.stats.ingots_per_hour.tip: Estimated as golems per hour times the expected drop. An iron golem always drops 3 to 5 iron ingots (uniform, expected 4). This is an estimate: drops are random and short samples can deviate a lot; stuck golems or golems falling into the void make the real number lower.
ironfarm.about.conditions.title: Iron golem spawn conditions
ironfarm.about.conditions.6: [Important: participants do not need to panic]
ironfarm.about.conditions.src: Full details in "Iron-Golem-Spawn-Conditions.txt" in the project root, sourced from decompiled 1.21.1 bytecode.
ironfarm.gui.stats.rate.tip: How many golems spawn per hour. This is a RATE, not a running total.
ironfarm.gui.stats.ingots_total.tip: Total iron ingots since recording started. Calculated as golems spawned times 4. A golem always drops 3 to 5 ingots (uniform, expected 4). Compare this directly against what you actually collected.
ironfarm.about.doc_missing: The conditions document could not be read. Check that assets/ironfarm/conditions/ is present in the jar.
ironfarm.gui.stats.spawned.tip: Total golems spawned since recording started. This is a running total, not a rate.
ironfarm.gui.items.total.tip: Sum of everything destroyed by hoppers pointing at a white wool block.
ironfarm.gui.items.per_hour.tip: Average items destroyed per hour, estimated from the total and the recording duration.
ironfarm.gui.items.none.tip: Point a hopper at a white wool block; its contents will be destroyed and counted here.
ironfarm.gui.settings.wool_hopper.desc: Voids a hopper's contents when it points into white wool, and records what was destroyed. Singleplayer only.
ironfarm.gui.settings.right_click.desc: When off, right-clicking a villager no longer opens the info screen; vanilla behaviour (trading) is unaffected.
ironfarm.gui.stats.elapsed.tip: Counted in game time, so it speeds up with tick accelerators
